spans.s:
घर् घर्, cl. 10. P. घारयति, -यितुम्, to
cover.
घरट्ट घरट्ट, अस्, m. a grindstone.

घर्घट घर्घट, अस्, m. a kind of fish,
Pimelodus Gagora or Tengara; [cf. गर्गर, गर्-
गरक, गर्गाट.]

घर्घर घर्घर, अस्, आ, अम् (an onomato-
poetic word implying an indistinct sound, especially
in the throat), uttered with an indistinct gurgling or
purring sound; (अस्), m. an indistinct murmur, a
low murmuring or gurgling sound, the crackling of fire,
rattling of a carriage, creaking, &c.; laughter, mirth; an
owl; a fire of straw or chaff; a door, gate; a sliding
or folding door or curtain (?); the pass of a moun-
tain (?); the N. of a river, the Gogra or Ghogra;
(आ), f. a bell hanging on the neck of a horse; (आ, ई),
f. a bell used as an ornament; a girdle of small bells
or tinkling ornaments worn by women; a kind of
lute; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. one of the tones or notes
in music.
—घर्घरा-रव, अस्, m. a tinkling
sound, the sound of small bells.

घर्घरक, अस्, m., N. of a river, = घर्-
घर; (इका), f. bells used as an ornament; a short
stick for striking several kinds of musical instruments;
a kind of musical instrument; fried grain; N. of a
river; an ornament of small bells.
घर्घरित, अम्, n. the grunting of a pig &c.

घर्घुर्घा घर्घुर्घा, f. a sort of insect
found in wood, = यम-कीट; [cf. घुर्घुर.]

घर्ब् घर्ब्, cl. 1. P. घर्बति, -बितुम्, to
move, to go.

घर्म घर्म, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घृ or घृण्),
heat, warmth (of the sun as well as of fire), sunshine;
the hot season, internal heat; sweat, perspiration; a
cauldron, a boiler, saucepan, &c., especially the vessel
in which the milk-offering to the Aśvins is boiled;
a cavity in the earth shaped like a cauldron or boiler,
an excavation; a crater; hot milk or any other hot
beverage offered as an oblation, especially to the
Aśvins; N. of a son of Anu and father of Ghṛta;
घर्म-तनू, du., N. of a Sāman; [cf. Gr. θέρμη;
Zend garĕma; Goth. varmja; Germ. warm.]
—घर्म-चर्चिका, f. eruptions caused by heat and
suppressed perspiration.
—घर्म-च्छेद, अस्, m.
cessation of the heat.
—घर्म-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
perspiring.
—घर्म-दीधिति, इस्, m. ‘having warm
rays,’ the sun; [cf. शीतांशु.]
—घर्म-दुघ, अस्,
आ, अम्, or घर्म-दुह्, -धुक्, क्, क्, Ved. giving
warm milk or the substance used for the offering.
—घर्म-द्युति, इस्, m. ‘having warm radiance,’
the sun.
—घर्म-पयस्, अस्, n. perspiration; warm
water.
—घर्म-पावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. drinking
hot milk.
—घर्म-मास, अस्, m. a month of the
hot season.
—घर्म-रश्मि, इस्, m. the sun; heat,
radiance; [cf. घर्म-दीधिति.]
—घर्म-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of heat, an epithet of
Indra.
—घर्म-विचर्चिका, f. cutaneous eruptions
or pimples from heat and suppressed perspiration; [cf.
घर्म-चर्चिका.]
—घर्म-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting
near the fire or living in the heat (of the sky), an
epithet of the manes.
—घर्म-स्तुभ्, प्, प्, प्, Ved.
assuaging the heat, an epithet of the Maruts.
—घर्-
म-स्वरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. breathing out heat;
(Sāy.) sounding high or shrill (= दीप्त-ध्वनि).
—घर्म-स्वेद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perspiring with
heat, or one whose sweat is milk; (Sāy.) coming
with splendor or showering down water or coming
to the oblation.
—घर्मांश (˚म-अंशु), उस्, m.
[]
the sun; [cf. घर्म-दीधिति.]
—घर्मून्त (˚म-
अन्˚), अस्, m. the end of the hot season, the beginning
of the rainy season.
—घर्मान्त-कामुकी, f. a
small white bird, a kind of crane; [cf. रलाका.]
—घर्माम्बु (˚म-अम्˚), n. sweat, perspiration.
—घर्माम्भस् (˚म-अम्˚), अस्, n. perspiration.
—घर्मार्त (˚म-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, suffering
from heat.
—घर्मोदक (˚म-उद्˚), अम्, n. warm
water, perspiration.

घर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. one who has prepared the
Gharma offering, engaged in preparing the Gharma.

घर्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the Gharma
or milk-vessel.

घर्ष घर्ष, घर्षण, &c. See under
rt. घृष्, p. 309.
घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing, grinding, friction, brushing.
घार घार. See under rt. घृ.

घार्तिक घार्तिक, अस्, m. (fr. घृत), pulse
ground and fried with clarified butter, a cake pre-
pared with Ghṛta or clarified butter.

घार्तेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe; (अस्),
m. the prince of this tribe.
घर्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbing; (अस्), m. a polisher.

घर्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbing, rubbing so as
to make sore; (अम्), n. the act of grinding or rub-
bing, pounding, brushing, friction; (ई), f. turmeric.
—घर्षणाल (˚ण-आल = आलय), अस्, m. a wooden
roller or pestle for grinding.
घर्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rubbed or cleaned.
घर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground, brushed.
घर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, grinding, rubbing.
